visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sweater and a fluffy white headband with blue ears, holds a small clear box containing a green character-themed makeup puff against a neutral indoor background. She smiles brightly at the camera. (2) Close-up shot focusing on a clear plastic cylindrical container filled with multiple beige finger puffs stacked neatly. The woman's hands, featuring long decorative nails, hold and rotate the container. (3) The woman presents her hand with five fingers each wearing a small, egg-shaped white finger puff decorated with various blue 'Hang Dun' character illustrations. (4) Extreme close-up of a single puff as the woman presses it with her fingers to demonstrate its soft, elastic, and high-density texture. (5) The woman applies liquid concealer under her eyes using a finger puff while looking into a pink circular mirror. (6) A montage shows her using the puff for various makeup steps: applying liquid highlighter to her cheekbones, tapping in liquid blush, and picking up powder from a compact for setting. (7) She uses the narrow tip of the puff to precisely blend cream contour along her nose bridge and eye sockets. (8) The woman poses for the final shot, holding the puffs on her fingers near her face and smiling warmly with high-key lighting.
